notes.title: Wild Romance Remastered - 5 Year Anniversary Update
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33669860/cea2f3c3255433c41064443aa2257524fad385d1.png[/img]

We’ve revamped and remastered the original Wild Romance for your viewing pleasure! This is a FREE upgrade for anyone that has already purchased the game!

This is the 5 Year Anniversary of Wild Romance to the day! We've added these new features that would satisfy any visual novel veteran:

[list]
[*] Complete overhaul in new engine
[*] Animated sprites
[*] More than one character on screen at once
[*] Toggleable character portraits in the text box
[*] Multilingual support within single executable 
[*] Upscaled high resolution graphics
[*] Rollback functionality
[*] Steam Achievements 
[*] English Japanese & now also including [b]Spanish[/b] 
[*] Now also available on MAC & LINUX
[/list]

A heartwarming traditional Japanese style visual novel has been revitalized for a new generation of readers. Enjoy the classic tale of Kazuma’s homecoming after an unfulfilling stint of life in Tokyo.

[b]Please note that this version of Wild Romance does not include any explicit sexual content.[/b]

notes.title: Summer Solstice specials - "Adult" Bundles on sale!
notes.content:
To celebrate the longest night of the year, for those living north of the equator, we wanted to remind everyone that Cherry Kiss also makes more "adult themed" visual novels than [i]Wild Romance[/i].  Many of you may be aware of this already and [b]if erotic anime content isn't your cup of tea then please accept our apologies, this sale isn't for you.[/b]  If however you're curious to check out some of our harder titles now is your chance.

When [i]Wild Romance[/i] was first launched the rules around "adult content" on Steam were different from today and it didn't include any of the extra juicy scenes of the Japanese original. It was designed to be a good story either with or without that extra content and if you've already picked it up we hope you've enjoyed.  [i]Wild Romance: Mofu Mofu Edition[/i] added in all that was missing.  That doubled the length of the story, [b]yup the hero Kazuma gets up to quite a lot of fun with his four furry eared friends![/b]  We also ported to a different visual novel engine and added some new features.  

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5305/Wild_Romance_Mofu_Mofu_Bundle/]Wild Romance: Mofu Mofu Bundle on sale now![/url]
Get [i]Wild Romance: Mofu Mofu Edition[/i] for 35% off if you already own [i]Wild Romance[/i] by completing the bundle set.  If you don't own it yet get an additional 35% off the already discounted price of [i]Wild Romance[/i] too!  

[i]Breeding Village[/i] is one of our most recent releases and being at the [b]complete other end of the adult content spectrum[/b] from [i]Wild Romance[/i] is perfect for those who want to make the leap from "soft" to "hard".  As the name Breeding Village suggests... well I think that's probably clear enough ;)

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/11025/Soft_to_Hard_Bundle/]Soft to Hard Bundle on sale now![/url]
Get [i]Breeding Village[/i] for 20% off if you already own [i]Wild Romance[/i] by completing the bundle set. If you don't own it yet get an additional 20% off the already discounted price of [i]Wild Romance[/i] too!  

Both of these special bundles will only be available until June 24.
